note: Seeded from the verified domain notes; ranks, reqLevels, and exact sources are nulled pending per-item verification at authoring.

consumables.name: Healing Potion
consumables.effect: Instant health restore; shares the potion cooldown. Keep the highest rank usable at level 19 on cooldown.
consumables.notes: Healing Potion (item 929, Requires Level 12) is the highest healing potion usable at 19; Greater Healing Potion requires level 21. Confirmed via Wowhead Classic item data.

consumables.name: Lesser Mana Potion
consumables.effect: Instant mana restore; shares the potion cooldown. Mana-using classes keep one on cooldown.
consumables.notes: For mana-using classes. Lesser Mana Potion (item 3385, Requires Level 14) is the highest mana potion usable at 19; Mana Potion requires level 22. Confirmed via Wowhead Classic item data.

consumables.name: Swiftness Potion
consumables.effect: Increases run speed by 50% for 15 sec; shares the potion cooldown. Flag-running and gap-closing tool in WSG.
consumables.notes: Item 2459, Requires Level 5. Shares the standard potion cooldown (trade-off vs a Healing Potion). Note: Free Action Potion (stun/root immunity) is NOT usable at 19 — it requires level 20. Confirmed via Wowhead Classic item data.

consumables.name: Rage Potion
consumables.effect: Instantly generates 20–40 rage; shares the potion cooldown. Opener burst for a rage-starved start.
consumables.notes: Item 5631, Requires Level 4. Useful to rage users (warrior, and druid in bear form). Shares the standard potion cooldown. Confirmed via Wowhead Classic item data.

consumables.name: Heavy Silk Bandage
consumables.effect: Channeled First Aid heal that does NOT share the potion cooldown; stack around a healing potion for extra effective healing. Breaks on damage taken and applies the 60s Recently Bandaged debuff.
consumables.notes: Item 6451, requires First Aid 125 (no character-level requirement); heals 640 over 8 sec. Best bandage usable at 19 — Mageweave bandages need Expert First Aid (level 20+). Schema has no bandage type; modeled as food (the off-potion-cooldown heal role). Confirmed via Wowhead Classic item data.

consumables.name: Rumsey Rum Black Label
consumables.effect: Persistent Well Fed-style buff: +15 Stamina for 15 min (does NOT share the potion cooldown). Pre-buff before a match for ~150 extra HP.
consumables.notes: Item 21151, no character-level requirement; grants +15 Stamina for 15 min (also applies mild drunkenness). Persists through the potion cooldown; strong 19 pre-buff. Obtained via AH/vendor. Confirmed via Wowhead Classic item data.

consumables.name: Elixir of Minor Agility
consumables.effect: +4 Agility for 1 hour. Persistent buff; does NOT share the potion cooldown.
consumables.notes: Item 2457, Requires Level 2. In Classic Era elixirs stack freely (no battle/guardian limit) and stack with the matching scroll (different buff aura), so run this alongside Scroll of Agility. Confirmed via Wowhead Classic item data.

consumables.name: Elixir of Lion's Strength
consumables.effect: +4 Strength for 1 hour. Persistent buff; does NOT share the potion cooldown.
consumables.notes: Item 2454, no character-level requirement. Stacks with Scroll of Strength and other elixirs in Classic Era. Confirmed via Wowhead Classic item data.

consumables.name: Elixir of Defense
consumables.effect: +150 armor for 1 hour. Persistent buff; does NOT share the potion cooldown.
consumables.notes: Item 3389, Requires Level 16. Highest flat-armor elixir usable at 19; stacks with Scroll of Protection II. Confirmed via Wowhead Classic item data.

consumables.name: Elixir of Minor Fortitude
consumables.effect: +27 maximum health for 1 hour. Persistent buff; does NOT share the potion cooldown.
consumables.notes: Item 2458, Requires Level 2. Small but cheap HP bump; stacks with the other elixirs. Confirmed via Wowhead Classic item data.

consumables.name: Scroll of Agility
consumables.effect: +5 Agility for 30 min. Stacks with elixirs (separate buff aura).
consumables.notes: Item 3012 (rank I), Requires Level 10. Best usable at 19 — Scroll of Agility II requires level 25. Confirmed via Wowhead Classic item data.

consumables.name: Scroll of Strength
consumables.effect: +5 Strength for 30 min. Stacks with elixirs (separate buff aura).
consumables.notes: Item 954 (rank I), Requires Level 10. Best usable at 19 — Scroll of Strength II requires level 25. Confirmed via Wowhead Classic item data.

consumables.name: Scroll of Stamina
consumables.effect: +4 Stamina for 30 min. Stacks with elixirs (separate buff aura).
consumables.notes: Item 1180 (rank I), Requires Level 5. Best usable at 19 — Scroll of Stamina II requires level 25. Confirmed via Wowhead Classic item data.

consumables.name: Scroll of Intellect
consumables.effect: +4 Intellect for 30 min. Stacks with elixirs (separate buff aura).
consumables.notes: Item 955 (rank I), Requires Level 5. For mana users. Best usable at 19 — rank II requires level 25. Confirmed via Wowhead Classic item data.

consumables.name: Scroll of Spirit
consumables.effect: +3 Spirit for 30 min. Stacks with elixirs (separate buff aura).
consumables.notes: Item 1181 (rank I), no character-level requirement. For mana-regen classes. Confirmed via Wowhead Classic item data.

consumables.name: Scroll of Protection II
consumables.effect: +120 armor for 30 min. Stacks with Elixir of Defense.
consumables.notes: Item 1478 (rank II), Requires Level 15. Best usable at 19 — Scroll of Protection III requires level 35. Confirmed via Wowhead Classic item data.

consumables.name: Heavy Sharpening Stone
consumables.effect: +4 damage to an edged weapon (sword/dagger/axe/polearm) for 30 min. Temporary weapon enhancement.
consumables.notes: Item 2871, Requires Level 15. Best sharpening stone usable at 19 — Solid Sharpening Stone requires level 35. Confirmed via Wowhead Classic item data.

consumables.name: Heavy Weightstone
consumables.effect: +4 damage to a blunt weapon (mace/staff) for 30 min. Temporary weapon enhancement.
consumables.notes: Item 3241, Requires Level 15. Blunt-weapon counterpart to the Heavy Sharpening Stone; Solid Weightstone requires level 35. Confirmed via Wowhead Classic item data.

consumables.name: Minor Wizard Oil
consumables.effect: +8 spell damage while applied to the weapon, for 30 min. For spell-damage casters.
consumables.notes: Item 20744, Requires Level 5. Spell-damage weapon enhancement (ZG-era, patch 1.11). Minor Mana Oil is NOT usable at 19 — it requires level 20. Confirmed via Wowhead Classic item data.

consumables.name: Thistle Tea
consumables.effect: Instantly restores 100 energy on its own 5-minute cooldown (does NOT share the standard potion cooldown). Rogue burst-energy tool for a flag grab or kill.
consumables.notes: Item 7676, Rogue-only, Requires Level 5; restores 100 energy, 5-min cooldown. Rogues can carry these at 19 (poisons unlock at level 20, so a 19 rogue uses no weapon poisons). Confirmed via Wowhead Classic item data.

consumables.name: Heavy Dynamite
consumables.effect: Thrown AoE fire damage (Engineering) — burst, finisher, and tag utility.
consumables.notes: Item 4378, inflicts 128–172 Fire damage in a 5-yard radius on a 1-minute cooldown; requires Engineering 125 to craft, no character-level requirement. Confirmed via Wowhead Classic item data.

consumables.name: Big Bronze Bomb
consumables.effect: Thrown AoE that damages and stuns everything in the blast (Engineering) — a 2-second stun to peel, set up a kill, or lock down a flag carrier.
consumables.notes: Item 4380, inflicts 85–115 Fire damage and stuns targets in a 5-yard radius for 2 sec (any damage breaks the stun; unreliable vs level 44+). Requires Engineering 140 to craft, no character-level requirement — any 19 engineer can carry it (Journeyman caps at 150). Confirmed via Wowhead Classic item data.

consumables.name: Explosive Sheep
consumables.effect: Summons a sheep that charges the nearest enemy and detonates for AoE fire damage (Engineering) — a deployable burst/tag tool that soaks a stealth opener or zones a chokepoint.
consumables.notes: Item 4384, summons an Explosive Sheep that charges a nearby enemy and explodes for 135–165 damage; lasts 3 min or until it detonates, 1-minute cooldown. Requires Engineering 150 to craft, no character-level requirement — sits right at the 19 Journeyman skill cap of 150. Confirmed via Wowhead Classic item data.

consumables.name: Portable Bronze Mortar
consumables.effect: Thrown AoE that damages and incapacitates everything in the blast (Engineering) — gnome-only at 19: a second stun-bomb only Gnome engineers can craft in-bracket.
consumables.notes: Item 4403, inflicts 100 Fire damage and incapacitates targets in a 5-yard radius for 2 sec (any damage breaks it; unreliable vs level 44+). Requires Engineering 165 to craft (schematic is a world drop) — at level 19 non-gnomes cap at 150 (Expert 151+ needs level 20), but the Gnome +15 Engineering Specialization racial reaches 165, so only Gnome engineers can make this in the bracket. Confirmed via Wowhead Classic item data.
